ideas.idea: Define explicit policies for search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot) separate from training crawlers, treating the GPTBot block as contradictory
ideas.why: GPTBot is a training crawler deliberately blocked per trainingCrawlers: block, so there is no contradiction; the claim reverses a deliberate choice.

ideas.idea: Render changelog server-side with a Remix loader and add structured dates and summaries
ideas.why: The loader fix is already a known problem, but adding dates and summaries to entries is a concrete extra improvement.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD (Organization, SoftwareApplication, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article/Product)
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is declared not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Replace the clickable div with a Link to /features
ideas.why: This restates the known problem of /features being reached only through a div with onClick.

ideas.idea: Add crawlable links to /, /features, /pricing and /changelog in the root nav, which currently omits home and Features
ideas.why: The nav in app/root.tsx links only /pricing and /changelog, so adding /features and / gives crawlers a real path.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata to public pages
ideas.why: This is accurate since none exists, but it mainly affects link previews and would apply to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Make page content more specific (integrations, use cases, pricing details, FAQs, evidence-backed claims)
ideas.why: The home page says only 'Integrates with all the tools you already use' and pricing says 'Talk to us for a quote', so specifics would help people and machines understand the site. The FAQ part is folklore, but the core advice holds.

ideas.idea: Generate origin, canonical URLs and sitemap from the real production URL instead of the .example placeholder
ideas.why: Real hard-coded placeholder hosts exist, but the .example domain is a reserved placeholder in this repo and the advice amounts to a standard deploy-time configuration step.
